name: Scheduled Tasks
description: Scheduled prompts/commands that fire into a reusable CLI session or run a cheap shell check and notify on a notable exit code. Migrated from the aw monolith (src/mcp/tasks.py + tools/agentic_output.py, src/api/task_manager.py + task_scheduler.py + routes/tasks.py, TasksTab.jsx).

skills.description: How to create/edit/run scheduled tasks (terminal CLI prompts or cheap-command-then-notify checks) through aw-app-tasks's /api/apps/tasks/* REST surface.

scheduler_interval_s.description: How often (seconds) the watchdog tick scans for due tasks and fires them. Minimum 1s.

terminals_api_base.description: Base URL of the workspace's own terminals API (core, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9123) used by 'terminal'-type tasks to create/reuse a CLI session and write the prompt into it. Leave unset to disable 'terminal'-type task execution — 'agentic_output' tasks work regardless since they run their command directly.

agents_platform_base.description: Base URL of the agents-platform-multitenant instance used by 'agent_prompt'-type tasks. Same value as aw-app-agents-platform-runners's own agents_platform_base config — 172.18.0.1 is the agentic-workspace_default bridge gateway (the real host), the only address reachable from this workspace's network namespace; override if your workspace's subnet differs. Leave unset to disable 'agent_prompt'-type task execution.

agents_platform_token.description: aw-backend identity JWT sent as Authorization: Bearer on every call to agents_platform_base — required, agents-platform-multitenant's require_identity() rejects unauthenticated requests with 401. Mint one inside the aw-backend container: python -c "from src.api.identity_auth import create_identity_jwt; print(create_identity_jwt(<user_id>, [{'workspace': 'aw', 'role': 'owner'}], expiry_seconds=<seconds>))"

agents_platform_target.description: target_slug sent with every 'agent_prompt' run — which Agents Platform Target (repo/workspace context) the agent runs against. 'adhoc' is agents-platform-multitenant's no-repo default target.
